# Game map: city (generated, do not edit by hand)

> Generated by `npm run map` by scanning this folder; paths are relative to it. Pages: /city.html, entry `main.js`.
> Content data is in `content/*.js` (condition/effect syntax: `node_modules/threedog/docs/recipes/20-content-actions-save.md`), which main.js hands to the engine with `engine.content.load()`; for the engine API read `node_modules/threedog/docs/API.md` (index) first, then only the module pages listed below.

Content: actions 1 · dialogues 1 · level 1 · npcs 1 · triggers 1

## Design decisions (hand-written, from DESIGN.md)

- **This example proves the engine is general-purpose**: it deliberately uses no terrain, vegetation or style pack, only the level module and a top-down camera. Do not add a style pack to make it prettier.
- **The map comes from the level scene**: spawn points, NPC spots and trigger zones are all marker points in the scene (content/level.js), so content files keep the same format when later switched to a Blender-exported glTF.
- **No inventory or quests module**: so content/ has no items or quests; to add them, first install inventory() and quests() in main.js's engine.use.
